dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nOUT = Path(\"outputs_diagram_v2\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nRNG = np.random.default_rng(42)\n\nclass Regime(str, Enum):\n    ESTABLE = \"ESTABLE\"\n    INESTABLE = \"INESTABLE\"\n    CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass CausalRole(str, Enum):\n    CAUSA_DIRECTA = \"CAUSA_DIRECTA\"\n    INDICADOR = \"INDICADOR\"\n    COMBINACION = \"COMBINACION\"\n    NULO = \"NULO\"\n\nclass Intervention(str, Enum):\n    HOLD = \"HOLD\"\n    REMAP_ONLY = \"REMAP_ONLY\"\n    DD_CONDITIONAL = \"DD_CONDITIONAL\"\n\ndef HIS(h_id, h_re, eps=1e-8):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") ============================================================\n# Hamiltoniano (inicio) + QPU + SEÑALES PUBLICAS\n# ============================================================\n@dataclass\nclass HamiltonianSpec:\n    n_logical: int\n    h_ideal: float\n\nH = HamiltonianSpec(n_logical=6, h_ideal=1.5)\n\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n_physical: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)  # physical qubits for logical\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\ndef evolve_qpu(n_phys: int, cycle: int, drift_qubits: List[int]) -> QPUState:\n    t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        if q in drift_qubits:\n            t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 5.0 * cycle)  # degrada claro\n        else:\n            t2[q] = 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.012 + (0.04 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 25.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -21.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.012 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 20.0)\n    # line + un anillo parcial\n    cmap = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\n    return QPUState(n_phys, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q, cmap)\n\ndef public_signals(qpu: QPUState) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Caja SEÑALES PUBLICAS del diagrama — unica fuente no privilegiada.\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"t1\": dict(qpu.t1),\n        \"t2\": dict(qpu.t2),\n        \"readout\": dict(qpu.readout),\n        \"detuning\": dict(qpu.detuning),\n        \"gate2q\": dict(qpu.gate2q),\n        \"coupling_map\": list(qpu.coupling_map),\n        \"n_physical\": qpu.n_physical,\n    }\n\ndef qubit_friction_from_signals(sig: dict, q: int) -> float:\n    f = max(0.0, 1.0 - sig[\"t2\"][q] / 150.0) * 0.35\n    f += max(0.0, 1.0 - sig[\"t1\"][q] / 100.0) * 0.15\n    f += min(1.0, sig[\"readout\"][q] / 0.05) * 0.25\n    f += min(1.0, abs(sig[\"detuning\"][q]) / 30.0) * 0.10\n    f += min(1.0, sig[\"gate2q\"][q] / 0.02) * 0.15\n    return float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n\ndef layout_friction(sig: dict, layout: List[int]) -> float:\n    return float(np.mean([qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q) for q in layout]))\n\nprint(\"QPU + señales OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.210832Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.211306Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.258002Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.211277Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.256955Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QPU + señales OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":70},{"id":"615fa071-6f7e-4f5b-8247-ed829629d3d7","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# OJOS: lee SOLO señales publicas → ranking continuo para MORPH\n# ============================================================\nclass Ojos:\n    def __init__(self, hist_n=8):\n        self.buf = []\n        self.capacity = hist_n\n        self.regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n\n    def observe(self, sig: dict) -> dict:\n        n = sig[\"n_physical\"]\n        health = {q: 1.0 - qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q) for q in range(n)}\n        friction = float(np.mean([1.0 - health[q] for q in range(n)]))\n        self.buf.append(friction)\n        if len(self.buf) > self.capacity:\n            self.buf.pop(0)\n        smoothed = float(np.mean(self.buf))\n        if self.regime == Regime.ESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.40: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n            if smoothed >= 0.55: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n        elif self.regime == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.55: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n            elif smoothed < 0.28: self.regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n        else:\n            if smoothed < 0.42: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n        candidates = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return {\"friction\": friction, \"smoothed\": smoothed, \"regime\": self.regime,\n                \"health\": health, \"candidates\": candidates}\n\n# ============================================================\n# REFLEJOS: n_logical < n_physical → puede evitar qubits malos\n# feedback rojo Observable puede re-pesar health\n# ============================================================\nclass Reflejos:\n    def __init__(self, n_logical: int):\n        self.n_logical = n_logical\n\n    def select(self, sig: dict, eyes: dict, obs_fb: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:\n        health = dict(eyes[\"health\"])\n        if obs_fb is not None and obs_fb.get(\"HIS\", 1.0) < 0.70:\n            # realimentacion Observable → Reflejos (flecha roja)\n            prev = obs_fb.get(\"layout\", [])\n            for q in prev[: max(1, len(prev) // 3)]:\n                if q in health:\n                    health[q] = max(0.0, health[q] - 0.10)\n        ranked = sorted(health.keys(), key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        edges = {(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in sig[\"coupling_map\"]}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden:\n                avoided += 1\n                continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a, b in edges:\n                if a == q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b == q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n        # si MIS corto, completar con siguientes mejores (sin romper n_logical)\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n            if q not in selected:\n                selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[: self.n_logical]\n        score = float(np.mean([health[q] for q in selected]))\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided}\n\nprint(\"Ojos / Reflejos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.259531Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.259869Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.291984Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.259832Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.291059Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Ojos / Reflejos OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":71},{"id":"49b87815-4b5d-43d4-841c-fd6ee74bc0d4","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# JUICIO: señales(QPU) + Observable → DD esporadico\n# MANOS: solo si Juicio autoriza\n# ============================================================\nclass Juicio:\n    def __init__(self, cooldown=4, do_z_min=0.32):\n        self.cooldown = cooldown\n        self.do_z_min = do_z_min\n        self.prev_his = 1.0\n        self.last_dd = -10**9\n\n    def decide(self, H, cycle, eyes, morph, obs_fb) -> dict:\n        do_a = max(0.0, 0.90 - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.6\n        do_z = eyes[\"friction\"] * 0.9\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            do_z += 0.18\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            do_z += 0.08\n\n        his_falling = False\n        if obs_fb is not None:\n            his_now = float(obs_fb.get(\"HIS\", self.prev_his))\n            if his_now < self.prev_his - 0.04:\n                his_falling = True\n                do_z += 0.10\n            self.prev_his = his_now\n\n        c, z = abs(do_a) >= 0.18, abs(do_z) >= 0.18\n        if c and z: role = CausalRole.COMBINACION\n        elif c: role = CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA\n        elif z: role = CausalRole.INDICADOR\n        else: role = CausalRole.NULO\n\n        cooled = (cycle - self.last_dd) >= self.cooldown\n        # DD esporadico: umbral alcanzable bajo deriva, no cada ciclo\n        want_dd = cooled and (\n            (do_z >= self.do_z_min and eyes[\"regime\"] in (Regime.INESTABLE, Regime.CONFLICTO))\n            or (his_falling and do_z >= self.do_z_min * 0.85)\n        )\n\n        if want_dd:\n            self.last_dd = cycle\n            inter, reason = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"causal_dd\"\n            gain = float(do_z)\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= 0.88:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.HOLD, \"hold\", 0.0\n        else:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.REMAP_ONLY, \"morph_active\", float(do_a)\n\n        return {\"role\": role, \"intervention\": inter, \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n                \"expected_gain\": gain, \"reason\": reason, \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z,\n                \"regime\": eyes[\"regime\"], \"his_falling\": his_falling}\n\nclass Manos:\n    def act(self, H, qpu: QPUState, plan: dict) -> dict:\n        dd = plan[\"intervention\"] == Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL\n        seq = \"CPMG\" if dd else \"NONE\"\n        phase = 0.0\n        if dd and plan[\"targets\"]:\n            phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in plan[\"targets\"]])) * 1e-3\n        qpu.layout = list(plan[\"targets\"])\n        qpu.dd_on = dd\n        qpu.dd_seq = seq\n        qpu.phase_vz = phase\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase,\n                \"layout\": list(qpu.layout)}\n\nprint(\"Juicio / Manos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.294492Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.294780Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.331511Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.294756Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T07:14:37.330634Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Juicio WORKLOAD + OBSERVABLE — baseline vs EQG sobre mismas señales\n# ============================================================\ndef run_workload(H, sig: dict, layout: List[int], dd: bool, phase: float = - min(0.95, fr * mit))\n    return {\n        \"layout\": list(layout),\n        \"dd\": dd,\n        \"friction\": fr,\n        \"mitigation\": mit,\n        \"H_ideal\": H.h_ideal,\n        \"H_real\": h_real,\n        \"HIS\": HIS(H.h_ideal, h_real),\n    }\n\nCONFIG = {\n    \"n_physical\": 12,\n    \"n_logical\": 6,\n    \"n_cycles\": 30,\n    \"his_floor\": 0.15,\n    # mitad del chip degrada (TLS) — MORPH debe preferir la otra mitad\n    \"drift_qubits\": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],\n    \"dd_cooldown\": 4,\n    \"do_z_min\": 0.32,\n}\n\nH = publicas\n\n    eyes = ojos.observe(sig)                       # Ojos ← señales\n    morph = reflejos.select(sig, eyes, obs_fb)     # Reflejos ← señales + obs\n    plan = juicio.decide(H, c, eyes, morph, obs_fb)\n    hands = manos.act(H, qpu, plan)                # Manos → QPU\n\n    # Baseline: layout ingenuo, sin DD (misma física/señales)\n    wl_base = run_workload(H, sig, BASE_LAYOUT, dd=False)\n    # EQG: layout MORPH + DD si autorizado\n    wl_eqg = run_workload(H, sig, hands[\"layout\"], dd=hands[\"dd_applied\"], phase=hands[\"phase_vz\"])\n\n    obs_fb = {\"HIS\": wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], \"H_real\": wl_eqg[\"H_real\"], \"layout\": hands[\"layout\"]}\n\n    if break_base is None and wl_base[\"HIS\"] <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_base = c\n    if break_eqg is None and wl_eqg[\"HIS\"] <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_eqg = c\n\n    hist.append({\n        \"cycle\": c,\n        \"eyes\": {\"friction\": eyes[\"friction\"], \"smoothed\": \"regime\": plan[\"regime\"].value, \"his_falling\": plan[\"his_falling\"]},\n        \"hands\": hands,\n        \"signals_snapshot\": {\"t2_drift0\": sig[\"t2\"][0], \"t2_good11\": sig[\"t2\"][11]},\n        \"workload_base\": wl_base,\n        \"workload_eqg\": wl_eqg,\n        \"observable\": dict(obs_fb),\n    })\n    mark = \" <<\" if hands[\"dd_applied\"] else \"\"\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - 1 or hands[\"dd_applied\"]:\n        print(\"c=%02d HIS_b=%.3f HIS_e=%.3f fr_b=%.3f fr_e=%.3f reg=%s %s dd=%s lay=%s%s\" % (\n            c, wl_base[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], wl_base[\"friction\"], wl_eqg[\"friction\"],\n            eyes[\"regime\"].value, plan[\"intervention\"].value, hands[\"dd_applied\"],\n            hands[\"layout\"][:4], mark))\n\nhis_b = np.array([h[\"workload_base\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist])\nhis_e = np.array([h[\"workload_eqg\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist])\ndd_n = sum(1 for h in hist if h[\"hands\"][\"dd_applied\"])\nprint(\"\\nDD %d/%d | mean HIS base=%.4f eqg=%.4f Δ=%.4f\" % (\n    dd_n, CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"], his_b.mean(), his_e.mean(), (his_e - his_b).mean()))\nprint(\"break_base=%s break_eqg=%s\" % (break_base, break_eqg))\nassert not np.allclose(his_b, his_e), \"layout/DD deben diferenciar baseline vs EQG\"\nassert dd_n > 0, \"DD debe
